name: sspur
description: A programming language for AI agents to write, read, and maintain. Native code faster than C++, effects and contracts checked by the compiler.

paragraphs: A programming language for AI agents to write, read, and maintain.

Documentation: sspurlang.github.io/sspur, with Get Started, the Handbook, the Reference and Tutorials. To try it without installing anything, open the Playground, which runs the checker and the interpreter in your browser.
Home: sspurlang.github.io · Packages: sspurlang.github.io/sspur-packages, the package registry, where you can search packages and publish your own.
features: Fewer tokens for agents. On 17 multi-step coding tasks, agents writing SSPUR used 0.67x the tokens of the same agents writing Python, and were level with TypeScript and Go (0.98x and 0.89x in total, 1.0x per task at the…

Every side effect is in the signature. log, fail[E], db.read[T], fs, proc, net, ffi, conc and user-defined effects are tracked by the checker, so a reviewer, or a deployer, can see exactly what a function is allowed to…

Contracts are checked, not just documented. pre, post, and refinement types (Int where > 0) are enforced at runtime, proved with Z3 where possible, turned into property tests by the fuzzer, and used by the optimizer to…
Edits are atomic. sspur edit replaces definitions by name, typechecks the whole codebase, and either applies everything or nothing. One call can edit and run the tests.

Safe and fast by default. Integer overflow, out-of-bounds access, and contract violations always trap. The native compiler proves most of those checks away, reuses memory in place when values are uniquely owned, frees…
